english_description: Start the battle with 5 stacks of {poision}.
Naturally gain 20% {toxicRes}. Lose 2 stacks of {poision} every second.
chinese_description: 自然獲得20%{toxicRes}，每秒減少兩層{poision}

english_description:
Whenever the character's {poision} stacks reach 0 during battle, immediately enter Sober. After gaining any {poision} stacks, Sober remains for 1 second before ending.
Sober effects:
	{attackSpeed} +30%
	{critRate} +20%
	Gain 5 {shield} per second.
chinese_description:
戰鬥途中每次身上{poision}層數歸零立刻進入清醒模式，有任何{poision}層數後滯留一秒消失。
清醒效果:
	{attackSpeed}+30%
	{critRate}+20%
	每秒獲得5{shield}

english_description: The lower the character's {hitRate}, the higher their {critRate}.
Each missed attack increases the {critRate} of the next attack that hits. This effect stacks and is cleared after an attack hits.
chinese_description: 每次攻擊未命中，增加下一次命中攻擊的{critRate}。效果可以疊加，攻擊命中後清空。

english_description: Each critical hit permanently increases {critRate} for the current battle.
chinese_description: 每次造成爆擊，永久增加本場戰鬥的{critRate}。
